% Figure dem_accuracy: generated by figures/rse_fig_dem_accuracy.py; placed where the text first discusses it.
% Model and display resolution, ATL08 datum constant, NMAD definition and the single-block sectors:
% Supplementary section rse_si_display.tex.
\begin{figure}[!tbp]
  \centering
  \includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{../figures/out/rse_fig_dem_accuracy.pdf}
  \caption{\textbf{Accuracy of the waterline elevation model against ICESat-2.}
  (a)~The waterline elevation model (height on the DAHITI reference) on the emerged seabed, with the \metric{h2.atl08.n_test_blocks} test blocks of \metric{h2.block_size_km}~km that hold ICESat-2 points (vermilion squares); checked sectors are named in bold.
  (b)~Model height against ICESat-2 ATL08 height for the $n = \metric{h2.atl08.n_test_points}$ test-block points on bare emerged seabed; dashed line, one to one.
  Mean error \metric{h2.atl08.dem.bias_m}~m, normalised median absolute deviation (NMAD) \metric{h2.atl08.dem.nmad_m}~m, root-mean-square error \metric{h2.atl08.dem.rmse_m}~m.
  (c)~Error (model minus ICESat-2) per sector and over all test blocks.
  Black circles, the elevation model against ATL08 (filled, mean; open, median); grey squares, the same against ATL06; coloured markers, each grid's mean error against ATL08 after its vertical offset fitted on training blocks.
  Shaded, $\pm\metric{params.checked_tol_m}$~m: a sector is checked when all four statistics of the elevation model lie within it.
  Off-axis values are drawn on the edge and labelled.
  (d)~NMAD of the elevation model (black) and of each grid against ATL08 (logarithmic axis).
  Right: ATL08 points and test blocks per row.}
  \label{fig:rse_dem_accuracy}
\end{figure}
